methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.

actual_scope: An opt-in forward-echelon rank evaluator for the unchanged complete PR5221 characteristic-five disjointness replay, retaining both primary and independent scientific command bodies.
scope_change_reason: The runtime card is narrowed to the measured row-reduction bottleneck in one fully source-bound consumer; no mathematical theorem is re-audited.
bottleneck_link: Implementation side result: less elapsed time for the same complete scientific replay, without new supplier credit or a kappa claim.
stop_rule: Ship the first verified complete-consumer improvement, with exact conformance, five alternating fresh-process pairs and unchanged scientific output.
evidence: README.md equivalence proof; verifier checks all 28 reached rank calls, all 15625 F5 2x3 matrices, 89 boundaries and 11 rejection controls. Five alternating fresh-process pairs have zero errors, identical output and nonoverlapping ranges.
